questions.scenario: Your family is going on a summer trip to a hill station like Manali or Shimla. What are you doing?

options.A: Filming a highly energetic 'mini-vlog', running around in the snow, and talking to the camera about the journey.
options.B: Explaining the geography of the mountains to your younger siblings or reviewing the car's mileage on steep roads.
options.C: Taking aesthetic sunset photos and making a slow-mo reel with a trending lo-fi Bollywood song.
options.D: Managing the trip itinerary, checking the hotel reviews, and making sure you got the best discount on MakeMyTrip.

questions.scenario: Your older cousin buys a brand-new smartphone during the Flipkart Big Billion Days. What is your reaction?

options.A: You grab it immediately to test the camera by recording a crazy dance or action video in the living room.
options.B: You check the RAM, processor speed, and benchmark scores to see if the specs actually justify the price.
options.C: You admire the sleek design, the matte finish, and take aesthetic flat-lay pictures of the unboxing.
options.D: You calculate exactly how much money they saved with the bank offers and exchange value.

questions.scenario: You and your friends decide to start a YouTube channel together. What is your main role?

options.A: I am the high-energy host doing public dares or eating spicy street food on camera.
options.B: I write the detailed scripts, research the facts, and make sure all the information we say is 100% accurate.
options.C: I spend hours on CapCut adding smooth transitions, color grading, and finding the perfect aesthetic fonts.
options.D: I look at the YouTube Studio analytics, figure out the best tags to use, and plan our upload schedule for maximum views.

questions.scenario: You are at the local mall on a Sunday evening. What is catching your attention?

options.A: Vlogging the chaotic experience, trying on random funny hats, and exploring the gaming arcade.
options.B: Going straight to the Croma or Reliance Digital store to test out the latest smartwatches and laptops.
options.C: Finding the perfect mirror in a clothing store for an OOTD (Outfit of the Day) picture with the best lighting.
options.D: Observing which stores have the most crowd and figuring out why their marketing strategy is working so well.

questions.scenario: It's Diwali time and the whole house is doing the annual 'Diwali Safai' (cleaning).

options.A: I film a chaotic, funny vlog showing the harsh reality of Indian household cleaning and my mom scolding me.
options.B: I research the most energy-efficient smart LED lights on Amazon and set them up to work with Alexa.
options.C: I arrange the diyas, marigold flowers, and rangoli perfectly to get that visually stunning, festive Instagram feed picture.
options.D: I manage the budget for the decorations and sweets, ensuring we get the best wholesale prices from the local bazaar.

questions.scenario: A new hook-step dance trend is blowing up all over Instagram reels.

options.A: I immediately learn the steps, set up my phone in the society compound, and record a high-energy version.
options.B: I make a 'Did You Know?' style video explaining the origin of the song and why the algorithm is pushing it.
options.C: I put my own artistic spin on it, making sure my outfit, background, and video quality are absolutely flawless.
options.D: I tell my friends the exact peak time (like 6 PM) to post their reels so they get the maximum reach and likes.

questions.scenario: Your friend's reel suddenly goes viral and hits 100k views! How do you react?

options.A: I celebrate wildly with them and immediately film a 'Part 2' video together to ride the hype wave.
options.B: I analyze the retention graph to see exactly at what second people stopped scrolling and watched the video.
options.C: I study the visual hook, the text font used, and the color grading to understand why it looked so appealing.
options.D: I tell them to put their email ID in their bio immediately so local brands can contact them for paid promotions.

questions.scenario: You are trying out a famous new street food stall (like a viral momo or chaat wala) in your city.

options.A: I record a reaction video trying the spiciest dish and challenging my friends to eat it without drinking water.
options.B: I analyze the ingredients and logically rate the food out of 10 based on the price-to-quantity ratio.
options.C: I take a perfect, close-up cinematic shot of the steam rising from the hot momos before anyone is allowed to eat.
options.D: I casually chat with the stall owner to figure out how many plates they sell a day and calculate their monthly profit.

questions.scenario: You saved up 1000 rupees from your pocket money. What are you doing with it?

options.A: Spending it on an impromptu auto ride and tickets to an amusement park with friends to make fun memories.
options.B: Saving it to buy a better mic, a ring light, or a cool tech accessory from Amazon for my setup.
options.C: Buying thrifted clothes from the local market or aesthetic fairy lights to completely makeover my room.
options.D: Using it to buy a premium editing app subscription or running a small ad to boost my page's follower count.

questions.scenario: When you imagine your dream career, what is the most important thing to you?

options.A: Being physically active, traveling the world, and sharing my raw, fun experiences with millions of people.
options.B: Being highly respected as the ultimate 'knowledge bank' who explains complex things in a simple way.
options.C: Being known for having the most beautiful, creative, and visually stunning aesthetic on the internet.
options.D: Being the mastermind behind the scenes, building huge brands, and making smart business deals.

Travel_Vlogger.title: Travel / Lifestyle Vlogger
Travel_Vlogger.primary_match_text: The Active Explorer! You are highly energetic, love being outdoors, and aren't afraid of the camera. You turn everyday moments into fun adventures.
Travel_Vlogger.day_in_the_life: Running around the city or traveling the world, talking to your camera, trying wild food challenges, and sharing your raw, unfiltered life with an audience who loves your personality.
Travel_Vlogger.alternative_match_text: TV Host, Event Emcee, Adventure Tour Guide
Travel_Vlogger.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th (Any Stream) -> Bachelor of Mass Media (BMM) or BA in Journalism & Mass Communication -> Self-taught video editing and storytelling skills via YouTube.

Tech_Edu_Creator.title: Tech / Educational Creator
Tech_Edu_Creator.primary_match_text: The Knowledge Guru! You are analytical, fact-driven, and love digging deep into the specs. You naturally explain complex things in a simple, logical way.
Tech_Edu_Creator.day_in_the_life: Unboxing the latest gadgets, reading heavy research papers, writing detailed scripts, and shooting informative videos that help people learn something new every day.
Tech_Edu_Creator.alternative_match_text: Tech Journalist, Subject Matter Expert, Data Analyst
Tech_Edu_Creator.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th (Science/Commerce preferred) -> B.Sc, BCA, or B.Tech -> Deep dive into a specific niche (Tech, Finance, Science) -> Master scriptwriting and research.

Aesthetic_Creator.title: Aesthetic / Art / Fashion Creator
Aesthetic_Creator.primary_match_text: The Visual Artist! You have a brilliant eye for design. You love perfection, colors, trends, and making everything look incredibly cinematic and beautiful.
Aesthetic_Creator.day_in_the_life: Spending hours perfecting your makeup or outfit, setting up the perfect studio lighting, shooting stunning slow-mo transitions, and heavily editing your reels on CapCut to match the beat perfectly.
Aesthetic_Creator.alternative_match_text: Fashion Stylist, Art Director, Professional Photographer
Aesthetic_Creator.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th (Any Stream, Arts preferred) -> Bachelor of Fine Arts (BFA), Bachelor of Design (B.Des), or Fashion Communication -> Master visual editing tools like Premiere Pro and Photoshop.

Influencer_Manager.title: Influencer Manager / YouTube Strategist
Influencer_Manager.primary_match_text: The Growth Mastermind! You have a sharp business brain. You love looking at analytics, understanding the algorithm, and finding ways to make money.
Influencer_Manager.day_in_the_life: Working behind the scenes at a talent agency. You look at YouTube analytics, negotiate high-paying brand deals with companies, plan content calendars, and guide creators on how to grow their channels.
Influencer_Manager.alternative_match_text: Digital Marketing Manager, PR Specialist, Talent Agent
Influencer_Manager.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th (Commerce preferred) -> Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) or Bachelor of Management Studies (BMS) -> MBA in Marketing or Digital Marketing Certifications.
